monthly_income.description: Total verified monthly income or inflow

monthly_emi.description: Monthly debt repayment and installment obligations

cash_flow_surplus.description: Net discretionary income after expenses and EMI

debt_to_income.description: Ratio of monthly debt obligations to monthly income

average_balance.description: Average daily bank or wallet account balance

income_stability.description: Normalized stability metric of monthly earnings

transaction_regularity.description: Consistency score of recurring digital transactions

savings_rate.description: Proportion of income retained as savings or surplus

failed_payment_count.description: Count of bounced checks, ECS rejections, or failed debits

recurring_obligation_amount.description: Recurring utility, rent, and subscription commitments

credit_history_available.description: Whether any formal bureau record exists

credit_history_length.description: Duration of formal credit relationship in months
